description: This file defines the SerialPortTimeoutException class, which is a custom exception used in the jSSC library for handling serial port timeout errors. It includes constructors and accessor methods for related properties such as port name, method name, and timeout value.

classes.name: SerialPortTimeoutException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating a timeout occurred during serial port operations, providing details about the port, method, and timeout duration.

methods.name: SerialPortTimeoutException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with port name, method name, and timeout value, and constructs an explanatory message.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port involved during the timeout.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method during which the timeout occurred.

methods.name: getTimeoutValue
methods.description: Returns the timeout value in milliseconds.
